name: asset-animation-demo
title: Asset Animation Demo
summary: A one-screen Flutter demo that plays generated character animations — proving assets can be generated in one consistent style, repeatably, with transparency, and played smoothly in a game.
stack: Flutter / Dart (the demo app) + Python (Asset-Gen-Framework, which the pipeline extends where a step is missing)

testing.command: cd src/asset-animation-demo && flutter test; cd src/Asset-Gen-Framework && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
prefer: This is a demo. One widget test that the screen builds and a button starts its animation, plus a parsing test for the catalog. Framework changes get one pytest each.
Everything about smoothness, size, and look is checked by running the app on the simulator, never asserted.
avoid: Golden tests, integration tests, and anything that asserts against a generated asset's pixels.
